evidence.excerpt: To answer questions, they are joined to a language model trained on captions and question-answer pairs.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: Trained in a single stage on 4.53M public samples with 32 visual tokens per frame, where open video LLMs use several stages, 9M to 172M samples and 64 to 256 tokens per frame on average, the resulting V-JEPA-LM models (1B to 8B, Qwen3 and Llama) lead every size class in average score across eleven video benchmarks; our 4B model scores 72.1, against 61.1 for the best open 4B and 64.8 for the best open 8B model.
